title: Clean up after an interrupted validation run

scenes.heading: A killed run can leave resources
voice: A forcibly terminated validation run can leave its Kubernetes objects behind.
The main branch adds a sweep command that identifies supported leftovers from earlier validation runs.

scenes.heading: Preview the candidate list
scenes.sub: Read the cluster context before applying.
voice: Start with a dry run and inspect the Kubernetes context and API server it prints.
Then check the exact list of candidate objects before deciding whether to apply cleanup.

scenes.heading: Protect active validation work
voice: Sweep looks at the resource age, expected ownership markers, and signs of a live run.
A retained validator Job guards run-scoped resources while the Job is still present.
scenes.result: Retained Job guards its run resources

scenes.heading: Confirm and recheck before cleanup
scenes.sub: The apply path reviews current state.
voice: Interactive cleanup asks for confirmation, then checks the live state before deleting eligible objects.
The result shows what was removed, so you can follow up on anything left behind.

viewer: Operators cleaning up interrupted validation runs
payoff: Preview which run-scoped resources sweep would remove and see the checks that precede deletion.
